caliper_mm.basis: derived.thickness; physical.caliper_um nominal: sheet grade designation

areal_density_kg_m2.basis: derived.areal_density (g/mm²) × 1000; physical.gsm estimated: density ≈ 0.90 g/cm³ × 300 µm (rsE §b)

E1t.basis: derived.E_md × t; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: 1.3–2.5 GPa (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um nominal: sheet grade designation

E2t.basis: derived.E_cd × t; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: cast sheet, near-isotropic (rsE §b) [E]; physical.caliper_um nominal: sheet grade designation

G12t.basis: derived.G12 × t, G12 = 0.387·√(E_md·E_cd) (Baum, Brennan & Habeger 1981, via pliego.stock.derive v1)

nu12.basis: ν12 = ν·√(E_md/E_cd): the card's ν is the geometric mean √(ν12·ν21), split by reciprocity ν12/E1 = ν21/E2; physical.nu estimated: typical PP value (rsE §b table script) [E]

D11.basis: derived.D_md × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_md_gpa estimated: 1.3–2.5 GPa (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: typical PP value (rsE §b table script) [E]; physical.caliper_um nominal: sheet grade designation

D22.basis: derived.D_cd × 1e-9 (N·m), plate E·t³/(12(1−ν²)) in pliego.stock.derive v1; physical.E_cd_gpa estimated: cast sheet, near-isotropic (rsE §b) [E]; physical.nu estimated: typical PP value (rsE §b table script) [E]; physical.caliper_um nominal: sheet grade designation

D66.basis: G12·t³/12 with the estimated G12 above

crease_length_scale_t.basis: physical.crease_length_scale_t estimated: L* ≈ 200·t measured on Mylar (Lechenault 2014); paper unmeasured

crease_yield_deg.basis: physical.crease_yield_deg estimated: living-hinge capable; fatigue differs from paper (rsE §b) [E]

crease_set_rate.basis: physical.crease_set_rate estimated: polymer hinge relaxes back toward flat [E]

notes: friction: the card states one paper-on-paper coefficient; it is written as friction_static, and friction_kinetic and damping are left out rather than invented
